::: {.cgp-footer}

```{ojs}
// The notice comes from config/site.toml through meta.json, so this is the one
// that is already shipped in the release bodies and the README rather than a
// fifth copy that can drift from them.
siteFooter = {
  const repo = (meta.releases && meta.releases.all
    ? meta.releases.all.replace(/\/releases.*$/, "")
    : "https://github.com/coatless-dashboard/costco-gas-prices");
  return html`<div>
    <p class="cgp-footer-notice">${meta.notice}</p>
    <p class="cgp-footer-notice">If you represent Costco Wholesale Corporation and would like
      anything here changed, corrected or taken down, please
      <a href=${repo + "/issues/new"}>open an issue</a> or write to the address in the
      <a href=${repo + "/blob/main/README.md"}>repository</a>. We will respond.</p>
  </div>`;
}
```

:::
